def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    bg=max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in grid))
    # Find longest contiguous horizontal runs of non-background cells.
    runs=[]
    for r,row in enumerate(grid):
        c=0
        while c<len(row):
            if row[c]==bg:
                c+=1; continue
            color=row[c]; a=c
            while c<len(row) and row[c]==color: c+=1
            runs.append((c-a,r,a,c,color))
    if not runs: return out
    # Repeated bars share color and left edge; extend the shorter bar with 1 to the far endpoint.
    best=max(runs)
    n,r0,a0,b0,color=best
    candidates=[x for x in runs if x[4]==color and x[2]==a0]
    if len(candidates)>=2:
        end=max(x[3] for x in candidates)
        for length,r,a,b,col in candidates:
            if b<end:
                for c in range(b,end):
                    if out[r][c]==bg: out[r][c]=1
    return out
